tests.title: Static no-REST runtime control audit
tests.description: Fail if OpenClaw or Metiq management adds external REST control endpoints or clients instead of Nostr events.

tests.title: Relay bus protocol response suite
tests.description: Cover OK false, all-relay reject, EOSE transition, CLOSED/auth-required, duplicate EVENT, reconnect/reissue, and validation gate behavior.

tests.title: No timeout or relay-close terminal state regression
tests.description: Assert terminal success/failure requires explicit result events and is not inferred from elapsed time, subscription close, or relay close.

tests.title: Draft-backed provisioning captures event id and spec hash
tests.description: Inject 31952 plus 5950 and assert exact draft id/spec hash are used even if a newer draft appears during the run.

tests.title: 31951 read model finalization ordering
tests.description: Assert final 31951 is published only after immediately-known runtime binding, capability, deploy status, and terminal result refs are set.

tests.title: Shared runtime-control fixture contract
tests.target_path: docs/soulfactory-runtime-control.md fixtures reused by Go and TypeScript tests
tests.description: Validate canonical 38384/38386 examples and method schemas in both Go and TypeScript without divergent field names or error shapes.

tests.title: 30317 capability publication and compatibility parsing
tests.target_path: OpenClaw and Metiq bridge tests plus Bahia adapter tests
tests.description: Assert runtime capabilities advertise soulfactory methods, schema version, controller trust hints, and relay hints; Bahia rejects incompatible capabilities.

tests.title: Souls UI capability-gated runtime selection
tests.description: Mock 30317 capability events and prove the UI exposes only supported runtime targets, saves 31952 drafts, and starts provisioning without polling for completion.

tests.title: Runtime request validation rejection suite
tests.target_path: OpenClaw bridge tests and swarmstr soulfactory_bridge tests
tests.description: Reject unsigned, unauthorized, stale, self-authored, duplicate, malformed, missing-tag, and misaddressed 38384 requests before side effects.

tests.title: Runtime idempotency replay behavior
tests.target_path: OpenClaw and Metiq bridge integration tests
tests.description: Replay the same idempotency key and assert the previous correlated 38386 result is returned without duplicating local agent/session mutations.

tests.title: Lifecycle 1950 progress/result compatibility
tests.description: Assert lifecycle actions publish 6950/7950 with request-kind/action/soul/agent-id/e tags and that any legacy alias remains migration-only.

tests.title: OpenClaw first vertical slice
tests.description: Prove 30317 discovery, 5950 to 38384 provisioning, 38386 result, final 31951/7950, and one 1950 to 7950 action for OpenClaw.

tests.title: Metiq first vertical slice
tests.description: Prove the same lifecycle path for Metiq using the documented soulfactory.* contract and existing ControlRPCBus semantics.
